# Dataset card template

Status: unfilled template. Replace every field with evidence before publication. Add the verified license metadata only after checking all source and derivative terms.

| Field | Required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Dataset identity | Version, content hashes and immutable artifact locations |
| Purpose | Observation replay, briefing evaluation or a precisely defined research outcome |
| Sources | Provider, edition, citation, access date and redistribution conditions |
| Geography and time | Bounds, date semantics, resolution and known coverage gaps |
| Processing | Source commit, command, environment lock, filtering and count reconciliation |
| Schema | Units, null meaning, time fields, provenance keys and valid categories |
| Labels | Definition, reviewer process, uncertainty, exclusions and disagreement counts |
| Splits | Temporal and geographic groups, row manifest hash and leakage checks |
| Composition | Actual records and independent events per split and relevant slice |
| Limitations | Reporting bias, sensor gaps, revisions and inappropriate uses |
| Privacy | Public inputs, removed identifiers and publication review |
| Maintenance | Maintainer, corrections process and superseded versions |

No performance results belong here unless actually measured on this exact version. A synthetic fixture must say synthetic and must not be presented as a NASA dataset. A no-record label is not evidence that no fire occurred.
